title: My Favorite Subjects
text:
My favorite school subject is science. We learn about animals and plants. Today we looked at a small frog under a microscope. It was very interesting.

I also like math. Math is not always easy for me. But my teacher helps me every day. Now I can add big numbers.

questions.text: What is the speaker's favorite school subject?
What does the teacher do every day?
How does the speaker probably feel about science class?
What can the speaker probably do to get better at math?

vocabulary.definition: a tool that makes very small things look bigger
making you want to learn more about something
gives someone what they need to do something

paragraph_translations: Benim en sevdiğim okul dersi fen bilgisi. Hayvanlar ve bitkiler hakkında öğreniriz. Bugün küçük bir kurbağaya mikroskopla baktık. Çok ilginçti.
Matematiği de severim. Matematik benim için her zaman kolay değil. Ama öğretmenim her gün bana yardım ediyor. Artık büyük sayıları toplayabiliyorum.
